question: Estimate the market size for online K-12 education (paid courses + tutoring + test prep apps) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Paid only — exclude free YouTube content? Yes.
Include test prep (JEE/NEET/UPSC for school-age students)? Yes for JEE/NEET (school age); exclude UPSC adult prep.
Categories: live classes, recorded courses, doubt apps, tutoring marketplaces? All.
After EdTech bust — current TAM realized? FY26 realized market.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: K-12 student population → those willing to pay for online supplementary education → annual spend.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Already taking some paid coaching offline: ~40-50M (concentrated in classes 8-12).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, in private schools or aspirational families
Already taking some paid coaching offline
Willing to pay for online supplementary at current price-points

calculationFlow: Average annual spend: ~₹8,000 (range: ₹2,000 doubt apps to ₹40,000 BYJU'S/Vedantu/PW comprehensive).
Plus offline-online hybrid (PW Vidyapeeth, Aakash digital, Allen Digital): ~₹3,000-4,000 Cr extra.
